key: The door seems to have been jammed shut.
en: The door seems to have been jammed shut.
ja: ドアは固く閉ざされているようだ。

key: "Vanhanen Castle"
en: "Vanhanen Castle"
ja: 「ヴァンハネン城」

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 05!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 05!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書05を手に入れた!

key: Info on Chess Arena now available!
en: Info on Chess Arena now available!
ja: チェスアリーナの情報が見られるようになった!

key: Hold it right there!
en: Hold it right there!
ja: そこで止まれ!

key: ...Was that convincing?
en: ...Was that convincing?
ja: ……説得力あったか?

key: RADOMUS: Regardless, it seems to have been enough to fool them.
en: RADOMUS: Regardless, it seems to have been enough to fool them.
ja: ラドマス: いずれにせよ、奴らをだますには十分だったようだね。

key: Didn't I say before--
en: Didn't I say before--
ja: 前に言わなかったかね――

key: Choose the right hat for the right job?
en: Choose the right hat for the right job?
ja: 適材適所の帽子を選べ、と?

key: Of course, one might wonder just how I had such an outfit as this in the first place.
en: Of course, one might wonder just how I had such an outfit as this in the first place.
ja: もっとも、そもそもなぜ私がこんな衣装を持っていたのか、疑問に思うかもしれないがね。

key: It almost makes me look suspicious.
en: It almost makes me look suspicious.
ja: これでは、まるで怪しい人物のようだ。

key: Now quickly, follow me.
en: Now quickly, follow me.
ja: さあ、急いで、ついてきなさい。

key: RADOMUS: I cannot stay long, but allow me to leave you with some clarity.
en: RADOMUS: I cannot stay long, but allow me to leave you with some clarity.
ja: ラドマス: 長くはいられないが、いくつか明らかにしておこう。

key: As you must have heard, they have captured Luna.
en: As you must have heard, they have captured Luna.
ja: もう聞いているだろうが、奴らはルナを捕らえた。

key: Unfortunately, I lacked the foresight to teach Luna to Teleport as well.
en: Unfortunately, I lacked the foresight to teach Luna to Teleport as well.
ja: 残念ながら、私にはルナにテレポートも教えておく先見の明がなかった。

key: Though if I could...
en: Though if I could...
ja: もしできていたなら……

key: More importantly, it would appear my gambit with Elias has not paid off.
en: More importantly, it would appear my gambit with Elias has not paid off.
ja: それより重要なのは、イライアスを使った策が、うまくいかなかったようだということだ。

key: After all, a normal Hypnosis only lasts so many turns, no?
en: After all, a normal Hypnosis only lasts so many turns, no?
ja: なにしろ、普通のさいみんじゅつは、そう長くは続かないだろう?

key: It would take a fierce power to play beyond those means, and we may only hope that no such things exist.
en: It would take a fierce power to play beyond those means, and we may only hope that no such things exist.
ja: それを超える手段には、相当な力が必要になる。そんなものが存在しないことを、願うしかあるまい。

key: Yet, it appears the logical conclusion has left him unmoved.
en: Yet, it appears the logical conclusion has left him unmoved.
ja: だが、論理的な結論だけでは、彼を動かせなかったようだ。

key: Still, I can predict his next move.
en: Still, I can predict his next move.
ja: それでも、次の一手は予測できる。

key: I suspect she will be somewhere around 7th Street in Reborn City.
en: I suspect she will be somewhere around 7th Street in Reborn City.
ja: 彼女は、リボーンシティの7番街あたりにいるだろう。

key: For reasons of my own, I must make myself scarce at present.
en: For reasons of my own, I must make myself scarce at present.
ja: 私自身の事情で、今は姿を見せるわけにはいかない。

key: I ask you go in my stead.
en: I ask you go in my stead.
ja: 私の代わりに、行ってもらいたい。

key: If you can't find that place, I suggest you contact someone who's a bit more familiar with the city's back-alley dealings.
en: If you can't find that place, I suggest you contact someone who's a bit more familiar with the city's back-alley dealings.
ja: その場所が見つからなければ、街の裏路地の事情に少し詳しい者に連絡することを勧める。

key: A gang leader in the city of some sort should suffice.
en: A gang leader in the city of some sort should suffice.
ja: 街のギャングのリーダーか何かで十分だろう。

key: Do you know anyone like that?
en: Do you know anyone like that?
ja: 誰か、そういう人物に心当たりはあるかね?

key: On another note, I'll beseech you allow me to keep this Amethyst Pendant a bit longer.
en: On another note, I'll beseech you allow me to keep this Amethyst Pendant a bit longer.
ja: ついでに言うと、このアメジストのペンダントは、もう少し私に預けておいてもらいたい。

key: I heard a story once about these 'keys' being purchased from a traveling merchant.
en: I heard a story once about these 'keys' being purchased from a traveling merchant.
ja: かつて、これらの「鍵」が旅の商人から購入されたという話を聞いたことがある。

key: I wonder who that might have been?
en: I wonder who that might have been?
ja: それが誰だったのか、気になるところだ。

key: As we said before, not all is black and white, or dark and light.
en: As we said before, not all is black and white, or dark and light.
ja: 前にも言ったが、すべてが白か黒か、闇か光か、というわけではない。

key: Wrong is sometimes right.
en: Wrong is sometimes right.
ja: 間違いが、時には正しいこともある。

key: In is often out.
en: In is often out.
ja: 内が外であることも多い。

key: And sometimes up may be the only way down.
en: And sometimes up may be the only way down.
ja: そして、上こそが下に至る唯一の道であることもある。

key: All you need to do is read between the lines--
en: All you need to do is read between the lines--
ja: 必要なのは、行間を読むこと――

key: Or rather, walk between them.
en: Or rather, walk between them.
ja: いや、むしろ、その間を歩くことだ。

key: Until we meet again, adieu.
en: Until we meet again, adieu.
ja: また会う日まで、さようなら。

key: Caught you!
en: Caught you!
ja: 捕まえたぞ!

key: Ugh, I should know better by now.
en: Ugh, I should know better by now.
ja: リカルド: くそ、もういい加減学習しろって話だよな。

key: Even if you beat me, I'm not letting you escape!
en: Even if you beat me, I'm not letting you escape!
ja: 俺を倒しても、逃がしはしないぞ!

key: Hold on, how did you get over here? We had it blocked off.
en: Hold on, how did you get over here? We had it blocked off.
ja: 待て、どうやってここまで来たんだ? 封鎖してたはずだろ。

key: You already got out, so why are you wasting time fighting me anyway?
en: You already got out, so why are you wasting time fighting me anyway?
ja: ヒルダ: もう外に出たんでしょ、なんであたしと戦って時間無駄にしてるわけ?

key: I should probably tell the others about this. They'll figure it out.
en: I should probably tell the others about this. They'll figure it out.
ja: 他の奴らにも伝えといた方がいいかもね。あいつらが何とかするでしょ。

key: Intruder sighted!
en: Intruder sighted!
ja: 侵入者発見!

key: Aren't you the one we're supposed to catch? Weren't you supposed to be on the inside?
en: Aren't you the one we're supposed to catch? Weren't you supposed to be on the inside?
ja: クリストファー: お前、俺たちが捕まえるはずだった奴じゃないか? 中にいるはずだったろ?

key: ...Huh.
en: ...Huh.

key: Uh, hi?
en: Uh, hi?
ja: あー、どうも?

key: So, you won't just get caught for us? Please?
en: So, you won't just get caught for us? Please?
ja: アマ: それで、大人しく捕まってはくれないわけ? お願い?

key: Even if we ask nicely?
en: Even if we ask nicely?
ja: 丁寧にお願いしてもダメ?
